name: multi-host-external-loadgen

base_results.finding: single external loadgen host capped at ~47k measured RPS at depth 4; validators under-driven

hypothesis: A single external loadgen host cannot drive 100k offered RPS across 12 endpoints because 12 concurrent kombat_loadgen processes contend for CPU. Distributing the 12 endpoints across 4 external loadgen hosts (3 endpoints each) should let each host's loadgen processes run without CPU contention, delivering the full 100k offered load to the validators.
planned_commands: Verify validator binary/config: KOMBAT_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/kombat_chain-live-dd022982 KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=... ansible-playbook playbooks/verify.yml

Copy loadgen binary to all 4 hosts: for host in root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.18 root@203.0.113.11; do scp -i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh chain/target-linux-x86_64/release/kombat_loadgen ${host}:/tmp/kombat_loadgen; done
Verify SSH to all 4 hosts works

Run: LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.18 root@203.0.113.11' LOADTEST_WRITERS_JSON=/tmp/and-live-261-rebuilt-v4-default-100k-60s/writers-all.json LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-265-multi-host-external-loadgen-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60
Verify correctness: bash chain/scripts/live_network_status.sh, curl kombat_getConsensusMetrics and kombat_getStateRootAtHeight on all four validators
Cleanup: for host in root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.18 root@203.0.113.11; do ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh ${host} 'rm -f /tmp/kombat_loadgen'; done

decision.next_move: Commit/tag/push the plan, verify SSH to all 4 hosts, copy loadgen binary, verify validators, reset state, run the profiled multi-host external loadgen replay.

result.classification: Multi-host external loadgen delivers 78,459 measured RPS, a 67% improvement over single-host 264b (46,907). All 4 loadgen hosts contributed. Delivery is balanced across v2/v3/v4 (7.2-8.3k RPS) but v1 remains bottlenecked at ~3.2k RPS/endpoint. The load delivery side is working — the remaining gap to 77k TPS is now validator-side, specifically validator-1.
